From b7ade35eb53a2455f737a623c24e4b24455b2271 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 14:45:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: dsa: hellcreek: Add STP forwarding rule

Treat STP as management traffic. STP traffic is designated for the CPU port
only. In addition, STP traffic has to pass blocked ports.

Fixes: e4b27ebc780f ("net: dsa: Add DSA driver for Hirschmann Hellcreek switches")
Signed-off-by: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Vladimir Oltean <olteanv@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Richard Cochran <richardcochran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
index c4f840b20adf..17d3a4a3582e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
+++ b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
@@ -1075,6 +1075,17 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
+	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry stp = {
+		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-00 */
+		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
+		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
+		.age	      = 0,
+		.is_obt	      = 0,
+		.pass_blocked = 1,
+		.is_static    = 1,
+		.reprio_tc    = 6,
+		.reprio_en    = 1,
+	};
 	int ret;
 
 	mutex_lock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
@@ -1082,6 +1093,9 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 	if (ret)
 		goto out;
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &p2p);
+	if (ret)
+		goto out;
+	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &stp);
 out:
 	mutex_unlock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c`**
   - A new static structure `hellcreek_fdb_entry stp` is added to define a forwarding rule for Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) traffic.
   - The `stp` entry is configured with the following properties:
     - MAC address set to `01-80-C2-00-00-00`.
     - `portmask` set to `0x03`, indicating that it is designated for management ports.
     - `age`, `is_obt`, and `is_static` are set to `0`, `0`, and `1` respectively.
     - `pass_blocked` is set to `1`, allowing STP traffic to pass through blocked ports.
     - `reprio_tc` is set to `6`, and `reprio_en` is set to `1`.
   - The new STP entry is added to the forwarding database (FDB) by calling `__hellcreek_fdb_add` after the existing entry for `p2p`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of the STP forwarding rule is directly related to the existing functionality of the forwarding database setup in the `hellcreek_setup_fdb` function. The new STP entry is added in conjunction with other entries, ensuring that STP traffic is treated as management traffic and can pass through blocked ports, which is a modification to the behavior of the switch's handling of network traffic. This change addresses the bug identified in the previous commit referenced in the patch.

Here is the commit message:
net: dsa: hellcreek: Add STP forwarding rule

Treat STP as management traffic. STP traffic is designated for the CPU port
only. In addition, STP traffic has to pass blocked ports.

Fixes: e4b27ebc780f ("net: dsa: Add DSA driver for Hirschmann Hellcreek switches")
Signed-off-by: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Vladimir Oltean <olteanv@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Richard Cochran <richardcochran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the lack of a specific forwarding rule for Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) traffic, which is designated for the CPU port only. Without this rule, STP traffic could be improperly handled, potentially leading to network issues, as it was not allowed to pass through blocked ports. The modification ensures that STP traffic is treated as management traffic and can traverse blocked ports, addressing this oversight.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 {
 	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry ptp = {
 		/* MAC: 01-1B-19-00-00-00 */
 		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x1b, 0x19, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
 		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
 		.age	      = 0,
 		.is_obt	      = 0,
 		.pass_blocked = 0,
 		.is_static    = 1,
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
 	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry p2p = {
 		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-0E */
 		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0e },
 		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
 		.age	      = 0,
 		.is_obt	      = 0,
 		.pass_blocked = 0,
 		.is_static    = 1,
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
+	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry stp = {
+		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-00 */
+		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
+		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
+		.age	      = 0,
+		.is_obt	      = 0,
+		.pass_blocked = 1,
+		.is_static    = 1,
+		.reprio_tc    = 6,
+		.reprio_en    = 1,
+	};
 	int ret;
 
 	mutex_lock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &ptp);
 	if (ret)
 		goto out;
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &p2p);
+	if (ret)
+		goto out;
+	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &stp);
 out:
 	mutex_unlock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 
 	return ret;
 }
